/cc @BenTheElder @wojtek-t @liggitt 

@smarterclayton you have added this test, do you see any reason why this test is never finishing on KIND (Kubernetes in Docker)

i.e this is a recent occurence
https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/88196/pull-kubernetes-e2e-kind/1266264458729099265

```
[32m• [SLOW TEST:3293.106 seconds][0m
```

it seems that one of the pods is stuck

> May 29 08:14:32.416: INFO: Pod pod-submit-status-2-12 on node kind-worker timings total=52m19.427066405s t=875ms run=0s execute=0s

opened https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91585 with debug info and a bound on how long we'll wait for pod events

see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91491#issuecomment-635577606 for rough timeframes when this started failing

Looking at a timed out test, I noticed the 35 minute gap toward the end of the build log:

https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/89155/pull-kubernetes-e2e-kind/1266582655445504000

May 30 05:25:17.491: INFO: Pod pod-submit-status-2-4 on node kind-worker2 timings total=36m25.229431893s t=1.812s run=0s execute=0s
```
For passing builds, there was no such gap in similar logs.
Also, similar log appeared at the early part of build log in the passing build.

I was looking at a recent failure:
https://gcsweb.k8s.io/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/91453/pull-kubernetes-e2e-kind/1266858347173253121/artifacts
```

There were 1573 occurrences of log lines in the following form:
```
May 30 23:10:00 kind-worker2 kubelet[673]: E0530 23:10:00.780763     673 remote_runtime.go:140] StopPodSandbox "719efe5645245b614ce69780ebdff7be982390d5551ad594ce39c84ff8450694" from runtime service failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded

```
1554 occurrences for kubelet.log on worker node 1.
```
-rw-r--r--@ 1 zyu  staff  5099478 May 30 18:59 pass-k2-kubelet.log
```
There were only 233 occurrences for the above kubelet.log from a passing e2e-kind test run.

probably not related but we did just change containerd versions quite a bit
due to an unrelated issue
https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kind/commit/ca0dde47d9597ade08db2cce5e2dd08f60f318cd

this kinda looks like the CI hosts being resource starved. might try
bumping the CPU req in the kind jobs (currently generally 2CPU), also
considering using memory backed emptydir for the docker storage in those
jobs (and hence most of what kind is doing) for some I/O isolation vs other
jobs ..
